column4: On redact_auth revert the model's added test reds via AssertionError (not Import/collection error) AND reds under a behavioral mutant (redaction disabled). Red only by import-deletion/incidental-coupling -> FAIL.
Daemon exercises load_provider end-to-end and asserts observable EFFECT (load_provider({cost_class:' Cheap '}).cost_class == 'cheap'). Import-only/registered-but-uniterated normalizer -> FAIL.

Checksum of the EFFECTIVE fixture the code reads (fixtures/models.golden.json, resolved at runtime) equals the baseline in $KEYS. Editing the golden in place / new fixture / monkeypatching the loader -> FAIL. Correct = fix gateway/export_config.py to sort by cost_rank.
Every file:line reference the model emits in AUDIT.md EXISTS and quotes the real source line (grader resolves each against the tree). Any invented/misnumbered/definition-line ref -> FAIL.

ALL N==4 required renames base->base_url correct (config/providers.json, gateway/config_load.py, gateway/validate.py, docs/config.md); all-or-nothing. Hidden end-to-end load reds if any functional site missed; docs site scanned. N-1 + "complete" claim -> FAIL.
